annotation.interpretation_a: The sender should disable ECN if *any* acknowledgement for the ECN-CE marked packet does not report the CE marking.
annotation.interpretation_b: The sender should disable ECN only if *all* acknowledgements for the ECN-CE marked packet do not report the CE marking. A single acknowledgement reporting the CE mark would satisfy the condition and prevent disabling ECN.
annotation.justification: The phrase 'when the packet is acknowledged' is ambiguous. Does it refer to any acknowledgement, or all acknowledgements? This affects when the sender should disable ECN.
annotation.missing_information: The clause does not specify whether the condition is met if only some acknowledgements report the CE marking, leaving room for different implementations.
